name: the loop ignores features.pageRequest and reuses the live document
why: Recent changes has no URL pages: without the hook the loop reads the site's own 20-change list as page 1 and never POSTs. The spec pins one POST and 200 rows.

name: the request asks for the site's default 20 per page
why: The request's whole point ("change to 200 revisions per page beforehand"): the spec pins perpage=200 in every POST.

name: the button's pageCount is ignored
why: "1,000" must POST pages 1 to 5; with maxPage fixed at 1 it would load 200.

name: the body's token is not the cookie's
why: Wikidot refuses a request whose wikidot_token7 field differs from the cookie (wrong_token7). The spec compares the two.

name: the site's form is not read
why: What the press loads is what the site's form asks for (revision types, category); the spec ticks two types and a category.

name: the category prefix stays in the Page title
why: The site prints "song: Going Home …"; Category holds the prefix and Page the title alone. The spec compares every Page cell with the title read independently.

name: "(new)" is not revision 0
why: A new page's revision is "(new)" on the site, revision 0 in Wikidot; the integer column needs the number. The spec pins every Revision cell and a sort that starts at 0.

name: the time is UTC, not the reader's
why: The site's own script shows a change's time in the reader's zone; the spec runs in Europe/Berlin and pins every Date cell.

name: a Wikidot error answer is taken as an empty page
why: status "wrong_token7" must fail the page (the loop stops), not render nothing and go on to pages 2-5.

name: the site's own list stays visible above the table
why: The live page shows the table only; the spec pins #site-changes-list hidden.

name: the site's select is not set to 200
why: The request: "change to 200 revisions per page beforehand". The spec pins #rev-perpage at 200 on load.

name: Relations: the sort name is never turned round
why: Name is "Bryan Adams" for "Adams, Bryan"; the spec pins five such names.

name: Relations: a band name with a comma is turned round too
why: "Crosby, Stills & Nash" is a name, not a sort form; the "&" after the comma tells them apart.

name: Relations: the group heading is not mapped to a Type
why: "Persons"/"Bands" become Person/Band; the spec compares every row's Type.

name: Relations: the tabview finder still looks for song links
why: _bbFindSongTabview() takes the link prefix; with "/song:" fixed the Relations tabview is never found and nothing is converted.

name: Relations: names keep their keyboard apostrophes
why: With sa_foreign_typography on, "D'Angelo" is "D’Angelo" in both name columns.

name: Relations: Load from Disk does not convert the fresh page's tabs
why: The reloaded page holds the tabview again; without the converter the file renders with the tabs still there.
